parameters.description: Controls whether to create a new contact or update an existing duplicate. **Scenario 1:** If this value is `true` and the location allows duplicate contacts, a new contact will be created immediately without checking for duplicates. **Scenario 2:** If this value is `true` but the location does not allow duplicate contacts, this field is ignored and the normal upsert behavior applies: the API will search for an existing duplicate contact, update it if found, or create a new contact if not found. **Scenario 3:** If this value is `false` or not provided, the normal upsert behavior applies regardless of the location's duplicate contact setting.
parameters.name: create_new_if_duplicate_allowed

description: Manage contacts, notes, tasks and tags in a LeadConnector sub-account.

leadconnector_new_contact_note_trigger.description: Runs for each new contact note in LeadConnector. Ones already there when the workflow is turned on don't start it. It can watch up to 4,000. How often it checks follows your workspace plan.

output.record: object with the fields id, body, userId, dateAdded, contactId, title, color, pinned

leadconnector_new_contact_task_trigger.description: Runs for each new contact task in LeadConnector. Ones already there when the workflow is turned on don't start it. It can watch up to 4,000. How often it checks follows your workspace plan.

output.record: object with the fields id, title, body, assignedTo, dueDate, completed, contactId

leadconnector_new_or_updated_contact_not.description: Runs for each contact note added or changed in LeadConnector. Ones already there when the workflow is turned on start it only when they change. It can watch up to 4,000. How often it checks follows your workspace plan.

output.record: object with the fields id, body, userId, dateAdded, contactId, title, color, pinned

leadconnector_new_or_updated_contact_tas.description: Runs for each contact task added or changed in LeadConnector. Ones already there when the workflow is turned on start it only when they change. It can watch up to 4,000. How often it checks follows your workspace plan.

output.record: object with the fields id, title, body, assignedTo, dueDate, completed, contactId
